summary: Router 0.37.0, locale-neutral defaults (ADR-0105, ADR-0106 proposed). Cost keys budget_month / price_per_m with the old _chf names as aliases (cost_keys.py), normalised per layer in Config.merged and Config.parse, in PUT /admin/config (settings paths, cloud model bodies, merge with stored roles.yaml settings, client deletion) and in the settings view; both names with different values are refused, never resolved silently. router.cloud.currency (display only, ^[A-Z]{3}$, EDITABLE as str maxlen 3, escaped in ui.html) in the provider snapshot, start log and an info metric. Wire fields, usage data and metric names unchanged; catalogue views add the old price field. router.benchmark.prompt (config.yaml only, nonempty, <= 4000 characters) sent to local nodes only, result records a SHA-256 prefix, the prompt is not logged. observe_light default resolved by the configuration check; fallback_observation reads only the configuration. English texts in nodes/tunnel/update status/common/admin hints. Traced: settings allowlist (settings.coerce/spec_for) still applies after renaming because neutral_path only maps the exact provider budget key onto its allowlisted neutral path; every budget reader (cloud.budget_month, request_block_reason, budget_problems, snapshot, metrics) reads the normalised spec built by _parse_cloud, so a budget written under the old name keeps limiting spend (TM-08); write_overrides validates the merged probe before writing, so the web UI cannot persist a conflicting pair; ha.py untouched (reads unchanged budget_view fields). No credentials, routes, auth, tunnel, enrollment, data-class or cloud-payload logic changed. Re-reviewed after merging main (problems.py/ADR-0101, agent without GPU, secrets renderer): cloud.budget_problems from #178 now calls cloud.budget_month, and budget_month / request_cost also read the old key on an entry built in code (selftest_problems.py builds provider specs with budget_month_chf directly) - found by that test after the merge and fixed so a budget can never read as 0 = unlimited because of its name (TM-08). The translated strings are not part of the problems.py message catalogue; the only message-text check left (agentupdate retry delay for old agents) concerns agent-sent text, unchanged.

limitations: No live router, real cloud provider or browser session; the web UI change was syntax-checked (node --check) and covered by the end-to-end API checks, not clicked through.
The Home Assistant cost sensor keeps the unit CHF (ha.py is outside this change); the budget problem text comes from the problems.py catalogue of ADR-0101 (de/en) and does not name the currency.
A roles.yaml edited by hand with both names and different values stops the router from loading the configuration (explicit error naming both keys) - intended fail-closed behaviour, documented.

Pre-existing, not introduced here: deleting a client in the same PUT that resets settings re-adds the reset settings from the stored file (admin._apply_delete_clients merges the stored block again); functional, not a security issue.
